notes.title: BLOODLETTER X GAMESCOM
notes.content:
[p][b]✨ Thank You, Gamescom! ✨[/b][/p][p]Last week we had the absolute pleasure of attending [b]Gamescom[/b], and we just want to take a moment to say a huge [b]thank you[/b] to all the wonderful people we met there! [/p][p]It was truly special to finally meet so many of you from our community in person and to give you a first glimpse at our upcoming [b]BLOODLETTER demo[/b]. Watching fresh faces dive into the game for the very first time was both exciting and inspiring for us as developers. Seeing your reactions, your strategies, and even your [i]dubious healing methods[/i] filled us with energy for the road ahead.[/p][p]We are incredibly grateful for your support and can’t wait to share the demo with the rest of you very soon. Stay tuned, little [b]Barber Surgeons[/b]—your patients are waiting.   May YOUR… dubious healing methods work!
[/p][p] The Aldamami Games Team

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483207/c495e31c5bef0e9f7e137b66834a41eb051b4fa8.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: TINY TEAMS by YOGSCAST
notes.content: [p]Greetings fellow barber surgeons to be, [/p][p][/p][p]We are super excited to share that BLOODLETTER was selected for this year's edition of Tiny Teams![/p][p]As part of this our demo will be streamed by YOGSCAST members Briony and Breeh on Sunday, August 10th 2025 between 11AM-2PM BST. [/p][p]You can watch the stream on the YOGSCAST [url="https://www.youtube.com/@yogscast"]YouTube[/url] and [url="https://www.twitch.tv/yogscast"]Twitch[/url] Channel, as well as the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025"]Tiny Teams Steam Page[/url]. We'll definitley be in the chat watching eagerly to see how they fare as barber surgeons. [/p][p]Alongside our game there will be streams from August 7th to Thrusday 15th showcasing all of the other wonderful games part of the lineup. [/p][p]We hope to see you there, too! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483207/13c7097ff494d83aca71ddfec42dd6e048e309f8.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483207/5963b3c54a51ff5971275984cf10b42283de8a32.png"][/img][/p]
